structure.cell_component_semantics: The Create/Proposed and Create/Accepted components share one source cell; likewise Edit. Splitting them into explicit semantic components is allowed only if their shared physical-cell identity and roles survive.

critical_structural_checks: Twenty paired cells retain slash-separated raw text and both Proposed/Accepted roles.
The top five rows are model averages over datasets; bottom five are benchmark averages over models.
Group headings, model-size tokens and caption numbering do not count as data values.
Lengths are markdown lines; count fields are creations/edits under the named group average.
